Firmus Secures Data Centre Deal with OpenAI in Malaysia

Firmus, a company backed by Nvidia, has signed a deal with OpenAI to provide data centre capacity in Malaysia. This agreement is significant for Firmus, which is reportedly preparing for initial public offering (IPO) meetings. The deal involves Firmus supplying capacity for OpenAI's artificial intelligence operations. The coverage also notes the involvement of other major technology players like Nvidia and Meta in relation to Firmus.
